「功勋战」则以当季存储数据为核心构筑思路，为想要较量策略思路的各位领航者，打造了在相近条件下比拼本赛季策略与操作的竞技场。"}]},{"type":"paragraph","children":[{"text":"我们希望不喜欢竞争的领航者能够轻松享受「大龟裂」，同时也为想要冲击高分与排名的领航者保留每个赛季研究打法的乐趣。"}]},{"type":"paragraph","children":[{"text":""}]},{"type":"paragraph","children":[{"text":"因此，此前曾取消的「大龟裂」赛季限制将于本赛季重新适用，恳请各位领航者谅解。"}]},{"type":"paragraph","children":[{"text":"今后我们将更为积极地听取各位的游玩感受与意见，持续改进，让更多领航者能以自己的方式享受内容。"}]},{"type":"paragraph","children":[{"text":""}]},{"type":"paragraph","children":[{"text":"■ c49.png/_tap_ugc.jpg","medium_url":"https://img2-tc.tapimg.com/moment/etag/deed59c880de8a5935771c6e10ea7c49.png/_tap_ugc_m.jpg","small_url":"https://img2-tc.tapimg.com/moment/etag/deed59c880de8a5935771c6e10ea7c49.png/_tap_ugc_s.jpg","original_url":"https://img2-tc.tapimg.com/moment/etag/deed59c880de8a5935771c6e10ea7c49.png","original_format":"png","width":1272,"height":713,"color":"0x737373","original_size":1155564,"large_url":"https://img2-tc.tapimg.com/moment/etag/deed59c880de8a5935771c6e10ea7c49.png/_tap_ugc.jpg"}}},{"type":"paragraph","children":[{"text":"每张「原罪」卡牌都指定了可减少罪恶值的条件，达成条件时即可减少罪恶值。 减少罪恶值的条件包含：发动非攻击卡牌、抽牌、生成卡牌等。"}]},{"type":"paragraph","children":[{"text":"此外，每当其他卡牌发动时，「原罪」卡牌的费用将会减少；费用归零后将替换为下一张「原罪」卡牌。"}]},{"type":"paragraph","children":[{"text":"但需注意，当第二张「原罪」卡牌的费用变为0时，若首领仍有剩余层数、或已历经一定回合，手牌中的卡牌将被全部清除，而「裁决之炽天使」将发动强力攻击。"}]},{"type":"paragraph","children":[{"text":""}]},{"type":"paragraph","children":[{"text":"反之，若满足「原罪」卡牌的条件并清除首领的全部层数，「裁决之炽天使」仅会发动较弱的攻击。"}]},{"type":"paragraph","children":[{"text":"因此，一边满足「原罪」卡牌的条件，一边清除首领层数，并抓住攻击机会造成尽可能高的伤害，便是攻略本次「大龟裂」首领的核心。 "}]},{"type":"paragraph","children":[{"text":""}]},{"type":"heading","children":[{"text":"【全新主战员「布蕾兹贝尔」预告】","bold":true}],"info":{"level":2},"fallback":{"type":"paragraph","children":[{"text":"【全新主战员「布蕾兹贝尔」预告】","bold":true}]}},{"type":"image","children":[{"text":""}],"info":{"img_url":"https://img2-tc.tapimg.com/moment/etag/736f040f2f948d407e04df509102b95f.png","image":{"url":"https://img2-tc.tapimg.com/moment/etag/736f040f2f948d407e04df509102b95f.png/_tap_ugc.jpg","medium_url":"https://img2-tc.tapimg.com/moment/etag/736f040f2f948d407e04df509102b95f.png/_tap_ugc_m.jpg","small_url":"https://img2-tc.tapimg.com/moment/etag/736f040f2f948d407e04df509102b95f.png/_tap_ugc_s.jpg","original_url":"https://img2-tc.tapimg.com/moment/etag/736f040f2f948d407e04df509102b95f.png","original_format":"png","width":1379,"height":776,"color":"0x999999","original_size":818700,"large_url":"https://img2-tc.tapimg.com/moment/etag
